fillInstructions.description: Fill the removed '10' with the same orange badge interior so the circle reads as continuous: a smooth orange gradient with a lighter yellow-orange highlight toward the upper-left and slightly deeper orange toward the lower-right.
continueEdges: Continue the badge’s radial/diagonal orange gradient seamlessly through both digit shapes and the inner hole of the '0'.
Preserve local luminance flow from surrounding orange pixels at each digit boundary (no hard seams or outlines).
Do not introduce new edges; only the existing smooth badge shading should pass through the removed text area.
fillInstructions.texture: Clean, flat vector-like fill with very subtle soft gradient; no grain or pattern.
